# Koi Knives

> Koi Knives specializes in premium Japanese kitchen knives featuring Australian wood-resin handles, blending Japanese steel craftsmanship with Australian design aesthetics.

Founded by S. Dolman, Koi Knives offers a curated collection of kitchen knives using Japanese steel (VG10, AUS10) combined with unique Australian-inspired handle materials and designs. The company provides complete knife sets, individual specialty knives, and storage solutions for both home cooks and professional kitchens.

## Key Topics

- Japanese steel (VG10, AUS10)
- Australian handles
- Kitchen knife sets
- Chef's knives (Gyuto)
- Kyoto collection
- Osaka collection
- Iconic River collection
- Damascus knives
- BBQ knives
- Nakiri & Bunka choppers
- G10 handles
- Knife racks
- Starter kits
- S. Dolman (founder)
- Adelaide Hills

## Featured Collections

- [Kitchen Knife Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/kitchen-knife-collection): Main kitchen knife collection by S. Dolman using Japanese VG10 steel
- [The Australian "Iconic River" Knife Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/the-iconic-australian-river-knife-collection): Iconic River collection featuring Murray, Yarra, and Daintree River designs
- [Kyoto Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/kyoto-knives-by-koi): Kyoto collection inspired by Japan's historic capital and founder heritage
- [Osaka Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/osaka): Osaka collection by S. Dolman with Japanese steel and wood-resin handles
- [Big Red Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/big-red): Big Red collection combining Australian toughness with Japanese steel design
- [Patina Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/industrial-collection): Patina collection for professional kitchens with HACCP-approved G10 handles
- [The Australian BBQ Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/the-australian-bbq-collection): BBQ collection featuring King of the BBQ knife and Ultimate BBQ Set

## Knife Sets

- [All Knife Sets](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/all-knife-sets): Complete range of Japanese knife sets including Damascus and Kyoto collections
- [3 Knife Set](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/3-knife-set): 3-piece knife starter kits including Hammered and Iconic River collections
- [6 Knife Set](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/6-knife-set): Premium 6-piece knife sets featuring Damascus, Kyoto, and Osaka collections

## Specialty Knives by Type

- [Chef's Knives](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/chefs-knives): Chef's knife collection including Gyuto and Murray River knife options
- [Choppers](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/choppers): Chopper collection including Nakiri, Bunka, and Ninja options
- [Serrated Knives](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/serrated-knives): Serrated knives for bread and bakery items using AUS10 Japanese steel
- [Carving Knives](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/carving-knives): Carving and slicing knives for roasts and BBQ including Daintree River knife
- [Boning Knives](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/boning-knives): Boning knife collection including Tassie Devil and Osaka Honesuki options
- [Paring Knives](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/paring-knives): Paring knives for utility slicing using AUS10 Japanese steel

## Dining & Accessories

- [The Dining Table Collection](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/the-dining-table-collection): Dining collection featuring Monet cheese knives and carving tools
- [Knife Racks](https://www.koiknives.com/collections/knife-racks): Knife storage and display racks including magnetic and wooden options
